metadata.title: Prisoners — Natural Light and Window Sources
metadata.description: An examination of the lighting approach for the interior scenes in Prisoners, focusing on motivated window sources and overcast exterior light.
metadata.author: Roger Deakins

content_html: The light in the Loki scenes was designed to feel cold and institutional...

blocks.text: The light in the Loki scenes was designed to feel cold and institutional.
We used the overcast sky as a large soft source through the windows, supplemented with very little fill.
